Momentum is the official loyalty program at Mohegan Sun. It consists of five tiers: Core, Ignite (2,500 Tier Credits), Leap (10,000 Tier Credits), Ascend (25,000 Tier Credits), and Soar (invitation only). 

You earn Momentum Points and Tier Credits through gaming, hotel stays, dining, and retail purchases. These points are redeemable for dining, hotel stays, or retail purchases. It is free to join at any Momentum Desk on the casino floor, online at mohegansun.com, or through the Mohegan Sun mobile app. 

You earn toward your next tier level with every dollar spent at the resort. Are you planning to visit mainly for the gaming floor or our dining options?
